title: Study on the functional testing of glaucoma surgical procedures using non-invasive stress tests
summary:
The aim of this study is to obtain more precise information about the pressure-lowering effect of glaucoma surgery. With the information gathered in this study, we hope to expand the diagnostic options for glaucoma patients with implants, improve pre- and post-operative care after glaucoma surgery, optimize treatment strategies, and determine optimal follow-up intervals.
During the scheduled follow-up appointments, various tests will be performed to determine intraocular pressure. In addition to a baseline measurement, these tests include monitoring intraocular pressure over time using a non-invasive pressure challenge test. This test is performed while the patient is lying down with their eyelids closed. Applying gentle pressure to the eye will induce temporary changes in intraocular pressure. These changes in intraocular pressure are then measured over a period of a few minutes. The pressure test is performed using a special device called an oculopressor. This is a research device used only within the context of the clinical study and is not used in routine clinical practice.

Furthermore, the position of the implant will be assessed postoperatively. For this purpose, an image of the iridocorneal angle of the eye is taken using a procedure called gonioscopy. This procedure is performed as a standard examination before and after glaucoma surgery, without the need for imaging.

interventions.name:
Patients requiring glaucoma surgery to regulate intraocular pressure.

The examinations are planned to be performed preoperatively and postoperatively at 6 and/or 12 weeks, as well as at 6 and 12 months.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Individuals with a confirmed diagnosis of glaucoma who are scheduled for surgical treatment.

The prerequisite is that the patients are capable of giving informed consent and agree to the procedure.
Exclusion criteria:
- Missing informed consent form
- Allergy to local anesthetic
